SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.FundingType AS funding_type
FROM
    schools AS s
JOIN
    satscores AS sa
    ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE
    s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.FundingType
HAVING
    AVG(sa.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.position > 1 THEN r.raceId END) /
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId),
        2
    ) AS percentage_not_first
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.year >= 2010;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS total_superheroes_with_blue_eyes_and_agility
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Blue'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Agility';

SELECT
  strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month,
  SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth AS ym
JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '2013'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth AS ym
JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND SUBSTR(Date,1,4) = '2013'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT pa.player_api_id AS player_id
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY pa.potential ASC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT
    c.CustomerID AS customer_id,
    (ym2012.Consumption - ym2013.Consumption) / ym2012.Consumption AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM
    transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN yearmonth ym2012 ON ym2012.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND ym2012.Date = '2012'
    JOIN yearmonth ym2013 ON ym2013.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND ym2013.Date = '2013'
WHERE
    t.Date = '2012-08-25'
    AND t.Price = 634.8;

SELECT c.CustomerID AS customer_id, (ym2012.Consumption - ym2013.Consumption) / ym2012.Consumption AS consumption_decrease_rate FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN yearmonth AS ym2012 ON ym2012.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND ym2012.Date = '2012' JOIN yearmonth AS ym2013 ON ym2013.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND ym2013.Date = '2013' WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25' AND t.Price = 634.8 LIMIT 1000000000

SELECT
    c.location AS Location,
    c.lat AS Latitude,
    c.lng AS Longitude,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS TimesHeld
FROM circuits AS c
JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Austria'
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.location, c.lat, c.lng;

SELECT
    member.first_name || ' ' || member.last_name AS full_name
FROM
    member
WHERE
    member.position = 'Treasurer';

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip AS full_communication_address

    schools AS s

    frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE
    s.EILCode = 'HS'
    AND s.County = 'Monterey'
    AND f.Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17) > 800
ORDER BY
    s.School;

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip AS full_communication_address
FROM
    schools AS s
JOIN
    frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE
    s.EILCode = 'HS'
    AND s.County = 'Monterey'
    AND f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
ORDER BY
    s.School;

SELECT DISTINCT st.language AS language
FROM set_translations AS st
JOIN sets AS s ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.baseSetSize = 180;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN s.id END) /
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.id),
        2
    ) AS female_percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT
    SUM(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS total_enrollment
FROM
    frpm AS f
JOIN
    schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE
    f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
    AND s.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
    AND s.City = 'Fremont';

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_cards,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fd.id) AS korean_versions
FROM
    cards AS c
LEFT JOIN
    foreign_data AS fd
    ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE
    c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
    AND fd.language = 'Korean';

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 *
        COUNT(CASE WHEN isTextless = 1 AND layout = 'normal' THEN 1 END) /
        COUNT(CASE WHEN isTextless = 1 THEN 1 END),
        2
    ) AS proportion_textless_normal
FROM cards;

SELECT AVG(m.home_team_goal) AS avg_home_goal
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Country AS c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Poland'
  AND m.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverId) / COUNT(DISTINCT r2.driverId),
        2
    ) AS race_completion_percentage
FROM
    results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    JOIN results r2 ON r2.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE
    ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS banned_white_border_cards
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
  AND c.borderColor = 'white';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverId) AS french_drivers_with_fast_lap
FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN drivers AS d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'French'
  AND lt.milliseconds < 120000;
